# PTDesign


## Installation

You can install the development version of PTDesign from [GitHub](https://github.com/toledo60/PTDesign) with:

```{r,eval=FALSE}
if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("toledo60/PTDesign")
```
